decisions: Keep prepare as an internal deterministic ActionLifecycleEvent that establishes the exact selected Standard Action as CurrentAction/prepared.
Do not add prepare to StandardActionId and do not create prepare-specific Run/Result semantics.

Do not STOP after internal prepare or ActionPackage formation; the ordinary STOP occurs once after the complete Standard Action invocation reports its admitted Result/continuation fact or its admission failure.
Keep prepared because it protects the single-current-Action interval before Result admission.
Preserve 049's recommendation to remove resumed/resume semantics unless independent review finds a current real requirement for them.
Keep Policy legality and automatic next execution outside this Change.
